home.title: The quiet of the desert, in M’ssici
home.subtitle: A camp, a farm and a village between Alnif and Rissani, on the edge of the dunes.
home.seoTitle: Mouzoun — Desert camp in M’ssici, southern Morocco
home.seoDescription: Nomad tents, a family farm and the village of M’ssici, between Alnif and Rissani: a quiet stay on the edge of the Moroccan desert.
home.introTitle: A family-run camp between the dunes and the palm grove.
home.introText: Life here follows the farm and the light. Days pass between the olive fields, the palm grove and the village; evenings around the fire, under a sky with no artificial light.
home.stayText1: Six furnished Berber tents and twenty pitches for your own, a few steps from the washrooms and the café.
home.stayText2: Breakfast is served facing the dunes: msemen, amlou and mint tea.
home.farmText1: Olives, dates and turnips grow the way they have for generations. The goats and camels are part of the family.
home.farmText2: Join the harvest or the milking, or simply walk along the irrigation channels.
home.quote: Here, the night still has all its stars.
home.practicalAccessText: On the N12 road, about 45 km from Rissani and from Alnif. 4×4 transfer on request.
home.practicalArrivalText: Check-in from 2 pm. Let us know if you arrive after dark.
home.practicalSeasonText: October to April: mild days and cool nights.
home.practicalBringText: Warm clothes for the evening, a head torch, shoes for the sand.
home.ctaTitle: A night under the stars is waiting
home.ctaText: Choose your dates and book online: instant confirmation.
